```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: teastore
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: teastore
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: teastore
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: teastore-config
  namespace: teastore
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: teastore-config
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: teastore
data:
  REGISTRY_HOST: "teastore-registry"
  REGISTRY_PORT: "8080"
  SERVICE_PORT: "8080"
  USE_POD_IP: "true"
  DB_HOST: "teastore-db"
  DB_PORT: "3306"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: teastore-db
  namespace: teastore
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: teastore-db
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: teastore
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  ports:
    - port: 3306
      targetPort: 3306
      name: mysql
  selector:
    app: teastore-db
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: teastore-db
  namespace: teastore
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: teastore-db
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: teastore
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: teastore-db
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: teastore-db
        app.kubernetes.io/name: teastore-db
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: teastore
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: db
          image: descartesresearch/teastore-db
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - containerPort: 3306
              name: mysql
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 512Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 1000m
              memory: 1Gi
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 3306
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 3306
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 20
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: teastore-registry
  namespace: teastore
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: teastore-registry
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: teastore
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  ports:
    - port: 8080
      targetPort: 8080
      name: http
  selector:
    app: teastore-registry
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: teastore-registry
  namespace: teastore
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: teastore-registry
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: teastore
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: teastore-registry
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: teastore-registry
        app.kubernetes.io/name: teastore-registry
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: teastore
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: registry
          image: descartesresearch/teastore-registry
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
              name: http
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: teastore-config
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 256Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 512Mi
          readinessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            tcpSocket:
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 20
            periodSeconds: 15
---

            tcpSocket:

            tcpSocket:
              port: 8080
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 20
```
